describes: The history layer registry (decisions §5 D5.1, D5.4, D5.6, D5.10). Each layer names its page and channel, the inputs its drive is baked from, the owner of its curve, what resets it and, once fitted, its law. The law (D5.1): one drive per texel per layer, and the layer's form says what it scales: an amplitude times its material's curve (polish, moss), or a rate into it (lichen). Each layer runs from one of its piece's clocks (the piece table: placed, disturbed and cleaned; bare = placed - the age brought; schemas/chunk-format.md, section 4), chosen per texel by a reach; speed and care are per thing; the date is the shader global _OS_Date, t below, in years. A clock never runs from before the piece was cleaned, where cleaning resets the layer. Delays and curve constants are the material's, in years (slate's here until step 4's material records hold them). A layer not yet fitted has no law. Every shader reads a layer through OS_History(address, layer) in one include, so a new layer takes a reserved channel or a new page and touches that include, never a kind. shared: baked on every page group. story: allocated per page group by the change query's weight, up to a cap; a group without it reads the material's quiet mean.

layers.reset: a new fill (the stone laid, a face re-dressed): the placed clock

law.curve: 1 - exp(-speed x min(t - clock, cap)), speed the thing's footfall / 400,000 a year, cap the material's (slate: 40); never under the piece's inherited polish

layers.reset: a new fill or coat (bare); a lift by hands, at the hands' reach (disturbed); a works campaign that cleans (cleaned)

law.clock: bare; disturbed at the hands' reach of a piece lifted by hands (from the face kind and edge distance: a tread within 6 cm of its edge, a nosing, a front)
law.curve: clip(drive x max(t - clock - delay, 0) / full, 0, 1), full the material's (slate: 200)

layers.reset: a new fill or coat (bare); the bed relaid, at the bed reach (disturbed); a works campaign that cleans (cleaned)

law.clock: bare; max(bare, disturbed) where h1.a >= 0.5 (the bed reach)
law.curve: min((t - clock) / full, 1), full the material's (slate: 60)
law.careFactor: 1.15 - 0.75 x care, care the thing's of year t - 1, a per-thing uniform: a care change costs a uniform, not a rebake
law.order: amplitude = clip(drive x scale x careFactor, 0, 1) x T, T = 1 - 0.85 x clip(trod x feet, 0, 1), feet from p0.r and trod the thing's. The clip comes before the trodden thinning: thinning first over-mosses every clipped texel (115/255 on the gully)

layers.reset: a new coat; a works campaign that cleans
a new coat; a works campaign that cleans
a new coat; the source removed and the face cleaned
a new coat; a works campaign that cleans

derived.law: depth = rate x h1.r x (t - placed) on walked treads, rate the thing's wear in metres a year (its material's wear, its footfall and its width; wear.py)

gives.held: clip((depth - 3 mm) / 3 mm, 0, 1): the water the dish holds

derived.rule: The dish tied to polish is a slate rule: a walked slate tread's dish takes the same share of the wear as its polish. A material that dishes without polishing takes uv4.y's hollow-rate (schemas/channels.json) or a channel of its own.
derived.note: No channel holds it. The hollow's geometry is still the mesh's at step 3; its shading is derived here.

readers.rule: A shader family reads only the pages it lists here (D5.10). Each is one sample a pixel, budgeted at 0.17 ms a 1440p screen at overdraw 1, inside S2's 0.5 ms; story pages count against D5.9 too. A family not listed reads no page.

notLayers.is: the bed reach: 0, moss runs from the bare year; 1, from the bed's last disturbance (the later of bare and disturbed). Binary, read at 0.5
